item.title: SCV 101: Candy Straight, CEO and Founder of Flamingo Box Co.
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda chats with Candy Straight, the CEO and owner of Flamingo Box Co. to learn about her upbringing in Southern California, as well as her educational background culminating with her graduation at the University of Southern California with a major in Sociology. Candy also shares why she decided to settle down in the Santa Clarita Valley and start her business Flamingo Box Co., a gift box company that aims to ease the burdens of their recipients
